title: Trace it: one withdraw call
scenario: A caller has a balance of 10. Step two calls through wallet/core.py.

steps.prompt: The caller calls withdraw(10, 11). What happens?
steps.why: 11 is more than 10, so the guard raises OverdraftError (C01).

steps.prompt: The caller calls withdraw(10, 3). What does BalanceTest check about the result?
steps.why: BalanceTest checks only the type. That is why V02 cannot fail.

title: Close a gap: the fee function
brief: No test calls fee(). Write a test that checks fee(250) is 3.
